name: University of Amsterdam (UvA)
header:
University of Amsterdam (UvA)
Netherlands · MSc Mathematics (2 years, 120 ECTS); subsequent employed PhD vacancies or separately funded doctoral route
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc-first route: ordinary employed PhD eligibility requires a master-equivalent qualification.
• ONE Science AMS award for September 2027; tuition remains payable.
• UvA and VU Amsterdam are different admissions institutions; do not reuse this dossier for VU.
• Van der Geer is emeritus, not represented here as a routine new primary supervisor.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a research-university mathematics bachelor of at least 180 ECTS or equivalent is assessed individually; a
UChicago math BA is an appropriate degree to submit, not automatic admission. US GPA 3.0 is advice, not a
hard minimum. An adjacent degree needs substantial advanced proof-based mathematics. PhD requires a
Dutch MSc or foreign equivalent and research/thesis experience; a BA alone is not the ordinary direct route. F-1
status does not establish Dutch nationality, fee status or residence permission. [s1] [s7] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Register Mathematics in Studielink (regular programme option; track chosen later in SIS); a nonresident can
register without DigiD. Allow up to 48 hours for UvAnetID/application email; activate SIS, upload PDFs, pay the
application fee at the final step, then submit. Alert two referees beforehand. Scholarship applicants must select
the AMS option and finish earlier. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require an agreed supervisor. Contact relevant faculty with a concrete mathematical
question or prospective thesis fit; availability is unconfirmed. The KdVI employee route explicitly does not
accept unsolicited job applications: apply to advertised vacancies. The independently funded route is
separately described and under construction. Faculty below are UvA, not automatically the separate VU
Amsterdam programme. [s1] [s7] [s8] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Studielink → UvAnetID → SIS application/track choice → PDF uploads → fee → submission → status monitoring →
accept offer within two weeks → certified verification/enrolment. Some legacy wording mentions DataNose;
follow the current SIS instructions in the application email. Official verification can take 3-4 weeks and an
unconditional email follows completion. [s1] [s4]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
AMS and tuition explicitly cover September 2027 / 2027-28. General application dates are standing and not
year-labelled. Employee doctorates are vacancy-based and normally MSc-entry. External PhD page is explicitly
under construction and employee salary text is demonstrably outdated. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s7] [s8]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing September-entry schedule: opens 1 October; non-EU/EEA applicants 31 January, EU/EEA 30 June,
stated 23:59 CEST. The page does not label the year and uses CEST even for January; confirm the 2027 portal
time zone. Current Dutch-degree applicants may use the later route, which does not cover an ordinary
UChicago BA. PhD vacancies set their own dates; no cohort deadline. [s1] [s7]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Amsterdam Merit Scholarship for September 2027: 15 January 2027 (time not stated). Submit the complete
MSc application and scholarship indication by this earlier deadline. Selection in March, notification in April. [s3]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Two recommendations must arrive within two weeks of submitting AND no later than the application deadline.
Thus submission close to the deadline does not create a two-week extension. Scholarship applicants should
complete the file by 15 January; a separate scholarship referee grace period is not stated. [s1] [s3]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required language evidence is due with the application by its deadline; an incomplete file is held. Waiver
documentation should be included. No GRE deadline is published. [s1] [s2]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Application PDFs by the relevant January/June or scholarship deadline. For September enrolment, final certified
documents are preferred by 1 July and required by 1 August on the verification page. Degree completion itself
must precede the programme, with 31 August mentioned; any later-than-August-1 graduation/document
exception needs confirmation. UChicago June graduation should allow timely verification. [s1] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Accept the offer in SIS within two weeks or admission/visa processing stops. Acceptance is not binding:
withdraw in Studielink by 31 August if not attending. Admission cannot simply be deferred; a new application is
needed next year. Tuition must be credited by the day before the programme starts. [s1] [s6]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, each 6.0; TOEFL pre-2026 scale 92, each 22; new scale 4.5 overall with
listening 5, reading/writing 4.5 and speaking 4.0. TOEFL Home Edition/MyBest are not accepted. Cambridge C1
175, each 170; C2 accepted. LanguageCert Academic 70, each 65; PTE Academic 71, each 65. Normally scores
must be within two years; Cambridge has an exception. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed full academic programme at an established US institution qualifies for the listed exemption; a
double degree with only part in the US does not. A completed UChicago BA should meet this rule. Confirm how
SIS records a pending BA waiver before graduation. This English exemption does not confer scholarship or fee
eligibility. [s2]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Neither GRE test appears in the public Mathematics MSc checklist. No explicit statement that optional scores
are considered, ignored or prohibited was found; do not invent a requirement. Doctoral vacancy instructions
control separately. [s1] [s7]

Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload degree certificate or graduation statement if already complete, current academic transcript, and an
English thesis/project summary if applicable. Originals not in Dutch, English, German or French require a
translation into one of those languages. Pending graduates also prepare their remaining-year course list. After
admission use official certified degree/transcript verification; student-forwarded registrar emails do not qualify.
Secure services such as Parchment/Digitary or direct registrar email to master-science@uva.nl are accepted;
include student ID. An official signed/stamped completion statement can replace an unissued diploma. [s1] [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
If the BA is unfinished, upload a self-prepared list of the courses still to be completed in its final year. No
separate complete mathematics-course inventory is listed beyond the transcript. [s1]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
MSc is not universally funded. For September 2027 the entire Faculty of Science offers ONE AMS award of
€26,125, paid monthly; tuition remains payable and this is not a tuition waiver. Mathematics non-EEA tuition
for 2027-28 is €26,000 per year; statutory tuition where eligible is €2,771. PhD employment is salaried: a
current Science vacancy gives scale P €3,204-€4,051 gross/month for 38 hours plus 8% holiday and 8.3%
year-end allowances, equivalent to €38,448-€48,612 base/year. This benchmark is not a math vacancy or 2027
guarantee; the old KdVI salary table is stale. [s3] [s5] [s9] [s7]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc normally two years. AMS second-year continuation requires at least 40 ECTS in year one and satisfactory
effort, attendance and progress; confirm the second-year amount in the award letter. Employed PhD normally
four years, with an initial one-year contract and positive evaluation for continuation (the general page also
describes a 3-5-year range). [s3] [s7]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
AMS is for non-EU/EEA/Swiss applicants, without Dutch statutory-fee/student-finance eligibility, not already
enrolled in a UvA MSc and not receiving another full-coverage award. Previous degree must be within three
years. Nationality - not US F-1 status - determines these conditions. International candidates can compete for
employee PhD vacancies subject to the project and immigration rules. [s3] [s7]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
AMS expects exceptional performance, roughly the top 10%; examples include US GPA at least 3.5, UK first or
Dutch 8. Other factors include institution quality, CV, extracurricular work and motivation. Applicant must

satisfy visa conditions and demonstrate additional funds. It cannot be treated as guaranteed tuition-plus-living
support. PhD contracts include research, training and teaching obligations. [s3] [s7] [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Indicate AMS interest in the MSc application and meet the earlier 15 January 2027 complete-file deadline.
Inspect SIS for the scholarship motivation upload location. A paid PhD requires an application to a specific
advertised job, not an MSc funding tickbox. [s3] [s7]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
External/home-country scholarships are possible but must be checked for AMS compatibility. The
independent-funded PhD page quotes €4,000/year fee, possible discretionary waiver and conditional teaching
opportunities, but explicitly says the programme is under construction; do not rely on this as a current funded
offer. It still requires MSc equivalence. [s8]
Application fee [Standing rule]
MSc international-degree application fee €100, nonrefundable, paid as the final submission step. Listed
methods include Mastercard/Visa, PayPal, Bancontact and iDEAL/Wero. Tuition is a separate charge; 2027-28
non-EEA mathematics tuition is €26,000/year. [s1] [s5]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Published exemptions include a Dutch bachelor, an application fee already paid for another UvA MSc in the
same year, and specified UAF-supported applicants (refund route). No general international hardship waiver
was established. [s1]

University of Amsterdam (UvA)
Netherlands · MSc Mathematics (2 years, 120 ECTS); subsequent employed PhD vacancies or separately funded doctoral route
Relevant European programme; no numerical ranking asserted
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• MSc-first route: ordinary employed PhD eligibility requires a master-equivalent qualification.
• ONE Science AMS award for September 2027; tuition remains payable.
• UvA and VU Amsterdam are different admissions institutions; do not reuse this dossier for VU.
• Van der Geer is emeritus, not represented here as a routine new primary supervisor.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a research-university mathematics bachelor of at least 180 ECTS or equivalent is assessed individually; a
UChicago math BA is an appropriate degree to submit, not automatic admission. US GPA 3.0 is advice, not a
hard minimum. An adjacent degree needs substantial advanced proof-based mathematics. PhD requires a
Dutch MSc or foreign equivalent and research/thesis experience; a BA alone is not the ordinary direct route. F-1
status does not establish Dutch nationality, fee status or residence permission. [s1] [s7] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Register Mathematics in Studielink (regular programme option; track chosen later in SIS); a nonresident can
register without DigiD. Allow up to 48 hours for UvAnetID/application email; activate SIS, upload PDFs, pay the
application fee at the final step, then submit. Alert two referees beforehand. Scholarship applicants must select
the AMS option and finish earlier. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require an agreed supervisor. Contact relevant faculty with a concrete mathematical
question or prospective thesis fit; availability is unconfirmed. The KdVI employee route explicitly does not
accept unsolicited job applications: apply to advertised vacancies. The independently funded route is
separately described and under construction. Faculty below are UvA, not automatically the separate VU
Amsterdam programme. [s1] [s7] [s8] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Studielink → UvAnetID → SIS application/track choice → PDF uploads → fee → submission → status monitoring →
accept offer within two weeks → certified verification/enrolment. Some legacy wording mentions DataNose;
follow the current SIS instructions in the application email. Official verification can take 3-4 weeks and an
unconditional email follows completion. [s1] [s4]
Cycle verification [Conflict]
AMS and tuition explicitly cover September 2027 / 2027-28. General application dates are standing and not
year-labelled. Employee doctorates are vacancy-based and normally MSc-entry. External PhD page is explicitly
under construction and employee salary text is demonstrably outdated. [s1] [s3] [s5] [s7] [s8]

Deadlines by stage
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing September-entry schedule: opens 1 October; non-EU/EEA applicants 31 January, EU/EEA 30 June,
stated 23:59 CEST. The page does not label the year and uses CEST even for January; confirm the 2027 portal
time zone. Current Dutch-degree applicants may use the later route, which does not cover an ordinary
UChicago BA. PhD vacancies set their own dates; no cohort deadline. [s1] [s7]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
Amsterdam Merit Scholarship for September 2027: 15 January 2027 (time not stated). Submit the complete
MSc application and scholarship indication by this earlier deadline. Selection in March, notification in April. [s3]
Reference receipt [Standing rule]
Two recommendations must arrive within two weeks of submitting AND no later than the application deadline.
Thus submission close to the deadline does not create a two-week extension. Scholarship applicants should
complete the file by 15 January; a separate scholarship referee grace period is not stated. [s1] [s3]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required language evidence is due with the application by its deadline; an incomplete file is held. Waiver
documentation should be included. No GRE deadline is published. [s1] [s2]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
Application PDFs by the relevant January/June or scholarship deadline. For September enrolment, final certified
documents are preferred by 1 July and required by 1 August on the verification page. Degree completion itself
must precede the programme, with 31 August mentioned; any later-than-August-1 graduation/document
exception needs confirmation. UChicago June graduation should allow timely verification. [s1] [s4]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Accept the offer in SIS within two weeks or admission/visa processing stops. Acceptance is not binding:
withdraw in Studielink by 31 August if not attending. Admission cannot simply be deferred; a new application is
needed next year. Tuition must be credited by the day before the programme starts. [s1] [s6]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
MSc: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, each 6.0; TOEFL pre-2026 scale 92, each 22; new scale 4.5 overall with
listening 5, reading/writing 4.5 and speaking 4.0. TOEFL Home Edition/MyBest are not accepted. Cambridge C1
175, each 170; C2 accepted. LanguageCert Academic 70, each 65; PTE Academic 71, each 65. Normally scores
must be within two years; Cambridge has an exception. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed full academic programme at an established US institution qualifies for the listed exemption; a
double degree with only part in the US does not. A completed UChicago BA should meet this rule. Confirm how
SIS records a pending BA waiver before graduation. This English exemption does not confer scholarship or fee
eligibility. [s2]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Neither GRE test appears in the public Mathematics MSc checklist. No explicit statement that optional scores
are considered, ignored or prohibited was found; do not invent a requirement. Doctoral vacancy instructions
control separately. [s1] [s7]

Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload degree certificate or graduation statement if already complete, current academic transcript, and an
English thesis/project summary if applicable. Originals not in Dutch, English, German or French require a
translation into one of those languages. Pending graduates also prepare their remaining-year course list. After
admission use official certified degree/transcript verification; student-forwarded registrar emails do not qualify.
Secure services such as Parchment/Digitary or direct registrar email to master-science@uva.nl are accepted;
include student ID. An official signed/stamped completion statement can replace an unissued diploma. [s1] [s4]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
If the BA is unfinished, upload a self-prepared list of the courses still to be completed in its final year. No
separate complete mathematics-course inventory is listed beyond the transcript. [s1]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No general course-description or syllabus upload requirement is published in the MSc checklist; admissions can
request evidence when assessing equivalence. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Two referee email addresses / two recommendations for the MSc. Doctoral posts have vacancy-specific
requirements. [s1]
Scholarship references [Unresolved]
The Science AMS page does not specify an additional referee or a distinct scholarship questionnaire. Do not
assume a third recommendation is required. [s3]
What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
The public Mathematics page requests two referee email addresses and tells applicants to ensure referees are
available. It does not say whether entering/saving details immediately sends the request. [s1]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
Letters may be received within two weeks after submission, subject to the hard application deadline. That
allowance does not establish whether invitations are sent only after submission. [s1]
Receipt confirmation [Unresolved]
SIS exposes application status/checklist information. A Mathematics-specific confirmation of recommendation
receipt, and whether applicants see per-referee status, was not established. [s1]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
No public Mathematics rule found for replacing an already submitted letter or reusing it between
programmes/years. Check the referee request and SIS before promising reuse. [s1]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
English CV in PDF including all previous education, explicitly including high school. No public page/word limit or
mandatory CV template found. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Self-written English motivation letter, maximum 500 words, uploaded as PDF. The programme page labels it a
motivation letter but gives no more detailed public prompt or font/margin specification. [s1]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
No separate personal/background statement is listed for the MSc. Any relevant context must fit the motivation
letter or an explicitly provided portal field. [s1]

No MSc research proposal listed. Employee PhD projects are advertised with topic/adviser; external PhD

See course-list field: unfinished-degree applicants list final-year courses still to complete. No prescribed

AMS motivation is capped at 500 words. Faithful prompt summary: explain choosing this MSc in the broader

not clarify whether this is a separate uploaded letter or the academic motivation letter plus scholarship
selection; inspect SIS before drafting two documents. No extra questions/format limits published. [s3]

evidence is distinct from the self-prepared final-year course list. [s1] [s4]

Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
MSc: a research-university mathematics bachelor of at least 180 ECTS or equivalent is assessed individually; a
UChicago math BA is an appropriate degree to submit, not automatic admission. US GPA 3.0 is advice, not a
hard minimum. An adjacent degree needs substantial advanced proof-based mathematics. PhD requires a
Dutch MSc or foreign equivalent and research/thesis experience; a BA alone is not the ordinary direct route. F-1
status does not establish Dutch nationality, fee status or residence permission. [s1] [s7] [s8]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Register Mathematics in Studielink (regular programme option; track chosen later in SIS); a nonresident can
register without DigiD. Allow up to 48 hours for UvAnetID/application email; activate SIS, upload PDFs, pay the
application fee at the final step, then submit. Alert two referees beforehand. Scholarship applicants must select
the AMS option and finish earlier. [s1] [s3]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
MSc admission does not require an agreed supervisor. Contact relevant faculty with a concrete mathematical
question or prospective thesis fit; availability is unconfirmed. The KdVI employee route explicitly does not
accept unsolicited job applications: apply to advertised vacancies. The independently funded route is
separately described and under construction. Faculty below are UvA, not automatically the separate VU
Amsterdam programme. [s1] [s7] [s8] [s10]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Studielink → UvAnetID → SIS application/track choice → PDF uploads → fee → submission → status monitoring →
accept offer within two weeks → certified verification/enrolment. Some legacy wording mentions DataNose;
follow the current SIS instructions in the application email. Official verification can take 3-4 weeks and an
unconditional email follows completion. [s1] [s4]

year-labelled. Employee doctorates are vacancy-based and normally MSc-entry. External PhD page is explicitly

Thus submission close to the deadline does not create a two-week extension. Scholarship applicants should
complete the file by 15 January; a separate scholarship referee grace period is not stated. [s1] [s3]

documentation should be included. No GRE deadline is published. [s1] [s2]

English requirement [Standing rule]
